t.name: Mount Rose Trail #814
t.description: A steep trail to a rocky perch with views of Lake Cushman and the southeastern corner of the Olympic Mountains.

t.name: Copper Creek Trail #876
t.description: This is a steep 2.1 mile trail that forms a short loop at the ridge top. At 1.3 miles the trail branches and ascends to the ridge crest separating the Copper Creek and Elk Creek watersheds and then loops back down to the trail branch.

t.name: Dry Creek Trail #872
t.description: The trail follows the shoreline of Lake Cushman before climbing over Dry Creek Pass and descending to Forest Road 2353-200.

t.name: South Fork Skokomish River Trail 873
t.description: This trail wanders through old growth forest and crosses the South Fork Skokomish River and other streamss befoe climbing up the national park boundary.

t.name: Pine Lake Trail
t.description: Walk along a gentle road-to-trail conversion along beautiful old growth groves to a placid lake deep in the Lower Skokomish Valley.

t.name: Church Creek Trail #871
t.description: This fairly steep 3.5 mile trail follows Church Creek towards a pass through a conifer forest, eventually ending near Satsup Lakes on Forest Road #2372.

t.name: Spider Lake Loop Trail #879
t.description: Hike through old growth forest around serene Spider Lake. This 1.9 mile loop trail is a level grade and gets yearly mainenance. Enter trail from either the North or South end of lake.

t.name: Brown Creek Nature Loop Trail #877
t.description: Brown Creek Nature Loop Trail is a 0.8 mile loop around a beaver pond and is a great wildlife viewing area. The trail has an easy grade along the south half, leaving from the Interpretive Trailhead. There are steeper grades along the north half.
